members.name: intents_flat_v10
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent does the message express? Pick the single closest intent.

criteria.activate_my_card: Wants to activate a card, or cannot activate it.
criteria.card_arrival: Card was ordered/sent but has not arrived yet; asks where the card is or how to track it.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: Asks how long card delivery takes or whether the card can arrive by a certain date / be sped up (before any delay).
criteria.order_physical_card: Wants to get or order a (new or first) physical card: where/how to get or order one, what it costs / whether it is free, whether it can be shipped to their country.
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting a PIN for the card: how to get a PIN for my card, where to find it, PIN not received, setting the PIN of a physical card that just arrived.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Wants an additional / second / spare card, e.g. for family or as backup.
criteria.card_linking: Wants to link or add a card to their account in the app: a new card that arrived, an existing card, or putting a found card back into the app.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or expired; how to get a replacement for the expiring card.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Asks whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, or wants a specific card brand.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: Wants to get or find a (non-disposable) virtual card; how to order one; why they don't have one.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: Wants to get a disposable (single-use) virtual card or asks how to create one.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Asks about restrictions or limits of disposable virtual cards (how many uses, who can get them).
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual or disposable virtual card is not working or was rejected when paying with it; or whether the virtual card can be used for certain payments (e.g. memberships, subscriptions).
criteria.card_not_working: Physical card does not work / was refused in shops or generally, without a decline-specific message about a payment.
criteria.card_acceptance: Asks where the card is accepted / which merchants or places accept it.
criteria.card_swallowed: ATM kept / swallowed / ate the card.
criteria.compromised_card: Worried that card details were stolen or someone else has access to the card, wants to freeze it or report fraud; mentions no specific purchase or withdrawal (at most 'these transactions' in general).
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Physical card lost or stolen, or found again after being lost.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost, stolen or left behind; how to use the account/app without it.
criteria.change_pin: Wants to change the current PIN, or set up a new PIN to replace it, or asks where/how to change it.
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked / account or card blocked after entering wrong PIN too many times; wants to unblock.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode / login code; wants to reset it.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Anything about Apple Pay, Google Pay or Apple Watch, including topping up through them or top-ups via them not working (this beats every other top-up intent).
criteria.declined_card_payment: A payment with the physical card (shop or online purchase) was declined/rejected/not accepted (not a virtual or disposable card).
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment/purchase is shown as pending or has not gone through yet.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was cancelled or returned to the customer, not by them ('my payment was cancelled', 'the money came back'); how to tell if a payment was reverted.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A payment or purchase the customer did not make or doesn't recognise: 'there is a payment I don't recognise', 'I didn't make this payment', 'a charge for something I didn't buy', a purchase someone made with their card (e.g. flights, gas).
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Charged a fee for paying by card / an extra fee on a card payment; also vague complaints about a 'hidden fee' or 'too many fees'.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A complaint that the exchange rate applied was wrong (generic 'the rate is wrong', or on a card purchase abroad).
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Charged twice / duplicate charge for one payment.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A specific small extra amount (an extra £1 / $1 / €1, a 1-pound or 1-dollar transaction) on the statement, even if pending or unrecognised.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer did not set up; also a vague 'charge' the customer didn't make ('an unauthorized/unknown charge', 'I was charged a payment I didn't make', 'can I dispute a charge') that names no purchase, merchant or card use.
criteria.request_refund: Wants money back for something bought: get a refund, cancel a purchase, return policy, how long a refund takes, item never arrived.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund the customer already asked for or expected has not appeared in the account yet.
criteria.atm_support: Where to find an ATM / which ATMs accept the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make (even if they say someone has their card info).
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM cash withdrawal declined / not authorised / card refused at ATM.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal shows as pending / in progress (e.g. ATM failed but transaction pending).
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave less (or different) cash than requested or than debited.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Exchange rates or fees for cash withdrawals abroad / foreign ATMs, or a wrong rate on cash taken out.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Auto top-up feature: whether it exists, how to set it, its limits.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer; also ANY question about SWIFT or SEPA transfers, even without a fee mentioned.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee for topping up with a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or a cheque; how to deposit cash or cheques.
criteria.topping_up_by_card: Topping up or 'transferring money' with a debit/credit card: how to, whether possible, a card top-up that didn't seem to complete, or a card top-up where the money disappeared.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, gave an error, or the card was declined for a top-up.
criteria.top_up_limits: Maximum/minimum top-up amounts, how much or how often one can top up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was returned/reverted/cancelled back (not a card top-up where the money simply disappeared).
criteria.pending_top_up: Top-up is pending, not available yet, taking a long time, or the money added by a top-up has not gone through yet.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification code / verifying the card used for a top-up.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to add money into the account from another bank account, how bank transfers work, or topping up by bank transfer (not about fees, not SWIFT/SEPA).
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Money coming into the account by bank transfer is not showing / balance did not change after a transfer; also 'how long does a UK transfer take, it isn't showing'.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Deposited cash or a cheque but the balance has not updated / it is slow.
criteria.transfer_timing: General question about how long transfers take to arrive (no specific stuck transfer), especially incoming transfers from the US or Europe.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer is pending, or has been waiting a long time / taking ages to clear; how long it will stay pending.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Sent money but the recipient has not received it; also generic 'I transferred money but it's not there yet' or 'too much time has passed'.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed, did not go through, keeps getting rejected or failing, or an error appears when trying to make a payment or transfer (e.g. a large payment for a flat or mortgage).
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was explicitly declined (the bank declined it / the customer is told it is not possible), e.g. despite having enough money.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel, stop, reverse or revert a transaction or transfer they made, including money sent to the wrong account or wrong account number.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Charged a fee for a transfer; also a bare 'why was I charged', 'will I get extra charges', or fees from using the account abroad.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary / beneficiary not allowed.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money / can someone send me money (incl. other currencies, salary).
criteria.exchange_rate: What the exchange rates are / where to find them (not a complaint about a wrong rate, not about cash withdrawals).
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies can be held or exchanged.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which cards (e.g. which credit cards, American Express) or which currencies can be used to top up / add money to the account.
criteria.country_support: Which countries are supported / can I use the service in my country.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity; what documents are needed; how long verification takes.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification or personal info is required; whether they really must verify, or can use the account before verification is done.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification failed or cannot be completed; app does not recognise them.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Source of funds: where to see or prove where their money comes from, seeing their available money, whether they must add their salary.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Change personal details or account information (name, address).
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account; accounts for children.
